versions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Ercedia RPG cinematic ultimate art, ONE illustration.
Reference images are SAME character identity and outfit designs, not poses to copy. Preserve exact face, age, gender, eyes, hair, physique, clothing, faction emblems and equipment visible in references. Character 아르센 4세 / ER-CORE-001. Text setting: 남48, 짙은 금갈색 짧은 머리, 푸른 눈, 은백 갑옷·청금 망토.
Approved technique: 왕관의 수호 · 결전식. Draw action: 왕실 장검을 세워 근위대의 빈틈을 메운다. Skill category: attack. Effect: 무기·손·접점 한 곳에 힘을 응축한 단일 발동. 짧은 검광 또는 국소 마나 효과.. Element: NONE: non-elemental physical/mana phenomenon; do not invent fire/lightning/holy magic. Limits: 시야·사거리·자세와 실제 지형에 제한되며 자동 적중·절대 방어가 아니다..
Regional context: 벨로아, 농경·기병·기사 문화; terrain . Background is an understated appropriate medieval fantasy environment supporting action, no extra named locations invented.
LOW restrained tier: a single narrow concentrated effect at hand/weapon/contact point. No full body aura, no enormous beams, no elemental storm. Proficient yet contained.
Camera: slightly elevated diagonal view, subject on right. Dynamic weight shift matching technique, visible hands properly connected to weapon/tool; defense/support stays defense/support, never converted into destruction. Keep face prominent and readable for an eventual face crop (face width roughly 16-22% of entire canvas). Focused, character-appropriate emotion, not automatic smile. Not front-facing standing portrait.
Style: polished 2D anime/cartoon fantasy in SAME visual quality as references, clean linework, rich readable game colors and painterly cinematic lighting. Background and effects fully painted as OPAQUE image. Wide horizontal 16:9 PNG ideally 1920x1080 or larger. Safe edges for face and key weapon/gesture. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, UI, frames, watermark or split panels. ONE character only. Absolutely SOLO character: no enemy bodies, hands, crowds, silhouettes, or extra figures. Do not draw an opponent, the threat remains outside the picture.  Weapon and equipment held naturally at the grip, no duplicate swords or extra limbs.
